validity_note: CoolProp reference Helmholtz equation of state (Span & Wagner, 1996) for carbon dioxide. Saturation properties only, tabulated from -40 to +25 degC. The critical point is 30.98 degC / 7377.3 kPa, just above the table top: this short table ends at +25 degC by design, because vapour-compression saturation (two-phase) data above the critical point does not exist - carbon dioxide operates transcritically there, as a single supercritical phase with no distinct saturation pressure. Values are for preliminary design; verify against vendor data for critical service.
